observations: MACK brand name visible on the front grille in photo 0.
The tipper bucket shows significant rust, surface wear, and possible previous repairs in photo 1.
Engine bay contains a turbocharged diesel engine in photo 2.

claims.evidence: The tipper bucket in photo 1 shows heavy rust and wear typical of local Nigerian use rather than a fresh import.

risks.proof: A video clip of the tipper bucket being raised and lowered fully.

risks.risk: Engine may have internal issues, blow-by, or excessive smoke.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running with the oil cap removed and a view of the exhaust.

risks.risk: Chassis frame may be cracked or heavily welded under the bucket.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the chassis rails from the mid-section to the rear.

risks.risk: Transmission may have gear selection issues or grinding.
risks.proof: A video of the truck driving through all gears.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Video of the tipper bucket operating (lifting and dropping).
Photo of the manufacturer's plate inside the door frame to confirm model and year.
response.reason: The item is clearly a Mack tipper truck. Due to the visible rust on the bucket and lack of operational proof, it is priced as a locally used unit in fair to poor condition.
